journey.name: M6 direct message in real time with seen receipt
journey.description: Signed in as journey.user, who follows journey.friend. Backend reachable. After step 6 the harness posts a reply from journey.friend through the API; after step 7 it marks the conversation read as journey.friend.

actions.action: Tap the "Messages" button in the top bar of the Home screen
Verify that the Messages screen is shown
Tap the "Back" button, tap the "Explore" navigation item, search "journey.fr" and tap "journey.friend"
Enter "Are you around?" in the "Message…" field and tap the "Send message" button
Verify that "Are you around?" is shown without "Sending…"
Verify within 10 seconds, without any tap, that the reply "Yes, right here!" appears
Verify within 10 seconds that "Seen" is shown under "Are you around?"
